findings.evidence: The diff of RegularLocalRing/AssociatedGraded.lean declares `associatedGradedEquiv_def`, `_apply`, `_homogeneousComponent`, `isHomogeneous_iff_associatedGradedEquiv_mem_range`, `homogeneousComponent_associatedGradedEquiv_symm`, `isHomogeneous_associatedGradedEquiv_symm_of`, `isHomogeneous_associatedGradedEquiv_symm_mk` and `associatedGradedEquiv_symm_mk_one`, but no `symm_mk_eval`. findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem associatedGradedEquiv_symm_mk_eval (hspan) (hlen) {ν} {F : MvPolynomial (Fin rs.length) R} (hF : F.IsHomogeneous ν) : (associatedGradedEquiv hspan hlen).symm (AssociatedGraded.mk (maximalIdeal R) ν ⟨F.eval (rs[·]), _⟩) = F.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk _)`, proved by `rw [associatedGradedEquiv_def]; exact IsWeaklyRegular.associatedGradedEquiv_symm_mk_eval _ hspan hF`.
findings.issue: No regular-local counterpart of `IsWeaklyRegular.associatedGradedEquiv_symm_mk_eval` (class of `F(x)` in degree ν ↦ `F.map (Quotient.mk 𝔪)`), although every other weakly-regular characteristic lemma (`_homogeneousComponent`, `isHomogeneous_iff_…`, `homogeneousComponent_…_symm`, `…_symm_of`, `…_symm_mk`, `…_symm_mk_one`) is mirrored. This is the initial-form statement §1.10 consumes, and the weakly-regular simp lemma cannot fire because `TauCeti.IsRegularLocalRing.associatedGradedEquiv` is a separate non-reducible def.

summary: The surface is otherwise well-sized and bodies stay hidden; the regular-local wrapper file mirrors every weakly-regular characteristic lemma except the initial-form inverse `associatedGradedEquiv_symm_mk_eval`, which the non-reducible regular-local def blocks from firing.
